{{Youmay|the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] concept of ''pride-father''|the Sakiyan concept of ''[[pride elder]]''}}
A '''''pride-father''''' was an elder member of a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan's]] pride, or clan. [[Tarnese Lyanne]] was the pride-father of [[Tarnese Bleyd]]. When the pride-father was disgraced due to black market deals gone bad, so was his junior family member.
